papers.t: Long-term agroforestry enhances soil organic carbon pools and deep soil carbon sequestration in the Indian Himalayas

Soil organic carbon stabilization inside microaggregates within macroaggregates is the major mechanism of carbon sequestration under a long-term agroforestry system in the foot hills of the Indian Himalayas
Soil carbon sequestration potential of different land use systems: evidence from sub-humid southern plains and Aravalli hills of Rajasthan, India
